judgement.reason: This repository is the ClickHouse database server (with the Keeper coordination service on port 2181), which clients connect to directly, not a web application, and the selected image installs a released package rather than building this source.

evidence.quote: * [Tutorial](https://clickhouse.com/docs/getting_started/tutorial/) shows how to set up and query a small ClickHouse cluster.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME "${DEFAULT_DATA_DIR}" (docker/keeper/Dockerfile), VOLUME /var/lib/clickhouse (docker/keeper/Dockerfile)
reviews.reason: The Dockerfile builds ClickHouse Keeper, a coordination service that keeps its logs and snapshots on local disk, and no shown line moves that data to a managed datastore.

reviews.findingEvidence: Server binds only to a loopback address: listen(PORT, '127.0.0.1', () (.claude/skills/diff-review/server.mjs)
reviews.reason: The loopback bind is in a developer tool script under .claude/skills, not in the production image built from docker/keeper/Dockerfile, which starts /entrypoint.sh.
